raw_response:
I have only 0.17 hectares here, so one full bag of fertilizer is too much and too expensive for me alone—this year I will share a bag of NPK with my cousin and put half on this plot, along with two cartloads of cow manure because I own this land and I want it to stay strong. I plant my own saved seed, not the hybrid kind, and I pull weeds with my hands because chemicals cost money I do not have. My wife and children will help me work this plot, and between planting, weeding, and harvest we will spend about eighteen days here. I will not hire anyone because the plot is small and I have no extra cash for wages.
